channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Private sector steps in to revitalize Japan’s rural communities
item.description: Such efforts are expected to help secure agricultural labor and broaden the ranks of people with continuing ties to the regions.

item.title: Japan’s newest female astronaut wants to speak Japanese on the moon
item.description: Ayu Yoneda, the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency's youngest astronaut, is mission-ready for her first flight.

item.title: Japan and Vietnam consider new pact to prevent crimes
item.description: The plan would allow them to mutually provide information on each other's nationals arrested or detained in their own countries.

item.title: Japan gets serious about defense spending hike as year-end deadline looms
item.description: The government and ruling coalition are reportedly considering nearly doubling defense spending over the next five years.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
